item.tib: mdo g.yung drung klong rgyas kyi dbang khrid gsal ba'i sgron me
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di ni rje rin po che dang mkhas grub g.yung drung tshul khrims gnyis kyi dbang khrid dang mdo 'di yi dbang rnams gcig tu spungs pa'i dbang khrid gsal ba'i sgron me 'di ni/ gshen gyi dge sbyongs bsod nams blo gros kyi (kyis) / rje mnyam med chen po'i zhabs pad spyi bor len (blangs) nas/ bdag 'dra blo dman rnams la phan phyir du/ bkra shis sman ri dgon du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
